description: This file defines the ConduitContext class, which is an Entity Framework Core DbContext implementation for the Conduit application. It manages database sets for articles, comments, persons, tags, article tags, article favorites, and followed people. The class configures entity relationships and foreign keys, and provides transaction management methods.

classes.name: ConduitContext
classes.description: Entity Framework Core DbContext for managing the Conduit application's database operations, relationships, and transaction handling.
